shortBio.en: AC/DC lead guitarist; school-uniform stage image and pentatonic leads over Malcolm’s grind.
shortBio.zh: AC/DC 主音吉他；校服舞台形象与 Malcolm 碾磨上的五声音阶主音。

body.en:
Born 1955. Co-founder with Malcolm. Lead figures stay inside blues-rock boxes at high gain; the brand is attack and showmanship more than modal complexity.

Constant across Bon and Johnson eras.
body.zh:
1955 年生。与 Malcolm 联合创始。主音音型留在高增益蓝调摇滚框内；品牌是攻击性与表演，多于调式复杂度。

跨 Bon 与 Johnson 时期的常量。
